summary.text: Daisy Hartsfield was appointed by Governor Josh Green on January 12, 2026 to fill the vacancy in House District 36 (Waipahu), and was sworn in on January 21, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Hartsfield is a third-generation Waipahu resident and graduate of Waipahu High School.
Hartsfield earned a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology, a Master of Social Work, and a law degree from the William S. Richardson School of Law at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.
